verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs explicitly describe an export tool that can include 'public and private data (with consent)' — private channel messages and DMs from consenting members — in a machine-readable export format used for migration/backup, directly matching the compliance-export story for a team-admin. This is corroborated by general export/import documentation and self-hosting docs confirming full data portability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the export tool's exact output format and confirmation of admin-level override for private data without member consent.
